name: Maona of Chios
native: Maona di Chio e di Focea

predecessors.name: Byzantine Empire
predecessors.text: Chios, under Byzantine governors since 1329 (Martino Zaccaria page)

successors.name: Ottoman Empire
successors.text: Chios, 'captured by the Ottoman Empire after the surrender to Piyale Pasha' in April 1566

ledger.x: 12 September 1346: the Genoese take the castle of Chios.
1566: the Maona of Chios ends after 220 years.

wars.name: Genoese conquest of Chios
wars.outcome: Simone Vignoso's Genoese fleet besieged the castle, which surrendered on 12 September 1346; a Greek uprising failed in 1347 and the Latins kept control; the Maona (a company of creditors) was formed on 26 February 1347.

wars.name: Ottoman conquest of Chios
wars.outcome: Piyale Pasha's fleet took Chios in April 1566 and annexed it to the Ottoman Empire.

certainty.note: An island: the coast is the border.
